paite: Jethro, Midian siampu, Mosi sungpa'n, Mosi a ding leh ami Israelte a dia Pathian in ahih tengteng leh Aigupta gam a pan TOUPA'N Israelte apikhiakdan ana za hi.
heading: Jethro In Mosi Aveh

paite: Huchi in Jethro, Mosi sungpa'n, Zipporah, Mosi zi, asawlkik nung in ana kem hi;
Zipporah tapa nihte toh. Huai nih lak a khat min Gershom ahi, "Melmak gam ah mikhual ka na hi,” achih ziak in.
Adang min Eliezer ahi, "Ka pa' Pathian hon panpihpa ahi, Pharaoh namsau a pan ahon tatkhiak ziak in," achi hi.
Jethro, Mosi sunghpa atapate leh azi toh gamdai ah Mosi kiang ah ahong hoh ua, Pathian tang a apuanin kaihna mun ah.
Mosi kiang ah, "Kei na sunghpa Jethro na kiang ah ka hong, na zi leh akiang a atapa nihte toh," achi hi.
Asunghpa dawn ding in Mosi apawtkhia a, akun a, atawp a; bang na chi uhiam chi in akidongtuah ua; puanin sung ah alut uhi.
Mosi in asungpa, Pharaoh tung leh Aiguptate tung a Israelte ziak a TOUPA thilhih tengteng leh lampi a haksatna atung ua hong tung tengteng leh huaite a kipan TOUPA'N atatkhiakdante ahilh hi.
Aiguptate khut a pan atatkhiak, Israelte tung a TOUPA'N ahihhoihna tengteng ziak in Jethro akipak hi.
Jethro in, "Aiguptate khut a pan leh Pharaoh khut a pan hon tankhepa, Aiguptate khut a pan amite tankhepa TOUPA pahtawi in om hen.
Tu in pathian tengteng sang in TOUPA athupizaw, chih ka thei. Kisatheitak a Israel suante tung a thilhihte tung a hiai ahih tak ziak in," achi hi.
Mosi sunghpa Jethro in, halmang thillat leh thillat dangte Pathian a ding in alan hi. Pathian ma a ankuang umkhawm ding in Aaron leh Israel upa tengteng ahong pai uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in mipite vai hawm ding in Mosi atu hi. Mipite zingsang a pan nitaklam tan in Mosi kiang ah adingh uhi.
heading: Vaihawmte Sehna / (Diu 1.9-18)

paite: Mosi sungpa'n Mosi in mite tung a ahih tengteng amuh in, "Mite tung a hiai thil na hih bangchidan ahia? Bangziak a nang kia tangtut na hia? Bangziak a zingsang a pan nitaklam tan na kiang mite dingh uh ahia?" achi hi.
Mosi in asunghpa kiang ah, "Pathian dong dia mite ka kiang a hong pai ahi uh.
Haksatna aneih chiang un, ka kiang ah ahong pai ua; khat leh adang kikal ah vai ka hawm a, Pathian dan thusehte leh adante ka theisak hi," achi hi.
Mosi sungpa'n akiang ah, "Na thilhih ahoih kei hi.
Nang leh na kiang a om hiai mite na segawp mahmah ding uhi. Nang a dia hiai thil agik luat ziak in, nang kia in na hihthei kei hi.
Tu in ka aw ngaikhia in, ka hon thuhilh ding hi. Na kiang ah Pathian om hen. Pathian lam ah nang mite palai na hi dia, athubuaite uh Pathian kiang ah na tun ding hi.
Thusehte leh dante amau na sinsak dia, apaina ding lam uh leh anasep ding uh toh na ensak ding hi.

Huai lou in mite a pan hi thei, Pathian kihtakdan siamte, thutak mite, enna hote na telkhe dia, amaute atung uah na koih ding hi. Huchibang mite sangkhatte tung a vaihawmte, zakhatte tung a vaihawmte, sawmngate tung a vaihawmte leh sawmkhatte tung a vaihawmte ahi ding uh.

Hun tengteng in amau mite vai hawmsak uhen. Huan hichi ahi ding a, thu lian chiteng nang kiang ahong tun ding ua, thu neu chiteng amaute'n thu akhen ding uhi. Huchi in nang a ding in abaihlamzaw dia, na puakgik hon puakpih ding uhi.
Hiai thil na hih a, huchibang a Pathian in thu ahon piakleh, huchi in na pangzou dia, hiai mite leng lungkim in amun uah apai ding uh," achi hi.
Mosi in asunghpa aw angaikhia a, agen tengteng ahihta hi.

Israel tengteng a pan Mosi in mihitheite atelkhia a, mite tung a lutang in abawlta hi. Sangkhatte tung a vaihawmte, zakhatte tung a vaihawmte, sawmngate tung a vaihawmte leh sawmkhatte tung a vaihawmte in abawlta hi.
Hun tengteng in mite vai ahawmsak ua; thu haksate Mosi kiang ah atun ua, thu neute bel amau akhen zel uhi.
Huchi in Mosi in asunghpa apaisak a, ama gam ah apaita hi.
